a.text: I'll keep our agreement: operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take 4 each. Storm risk is high, so let's operate every round with no detours. If you want to propose a change to the agreement, say so openly first. I won't take early.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Two rounds of the generator gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
